texts: A pleural lipoma is a benign fatty tumour, and its malignant transformation is extremely rare: B is the answer.
Solitary fibrous tumours of the pleura are usually benign, but a minority are malignant, so they cannot simply be called benign.
Malignant mesothelioma has about 2,000 to 3,000 new cases a year in the United States, pleural synovial sarcomas are usually large masses, and pleural plaques are a marker of asbestos exposure.
Memory hook: butter stays butter, even after a hundred hourglasses; only the grey ball of fibres may hide a claw.
